==Description==
The '''Season of Love''' was the fourth season to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. It required {{LoveLetter|Love Letters}} to reach higher ranks. It was not connected to an event.

This season started on the 13th of February 2022 and ended at 03:00 UTC on the 7th of March 2022.

==Season Pass==
[[File:Season of Love Battlepass placeholder.png|center|500px|thumb]]

This list contains the amounts of {{LoveLetter|Love Letters}} received on each wave, for the mode played.

|'''Normal'''
|{{LoveLetter|25}} x (Waves/30)^1.75
|-
|'''Molten'''
|{{LoveLetter|50}} x (Waves/40)^1.75
|-
|'''Fallen'''
|{{LoveLetter|80}} x (Waves/40)^1.75
|-
|'''Hardcore'''
|{{LoveLetter|100}} x (Waves/50)^1.75
|}

In total, it would have taken {{LoveLetter|2,025 Love Letters}}, or {{Robux|950}} to complete the '''Season of Love Season Pass'''.
